mathematical_change.name: CutOpenEvent.PairingCompatible
mathematical_change.statement: Every cut-open birth or death pairs two strands on the same framed component with opposite orientations.
mathematical_change.reason: Without same-component and opposite-orientation data, a later categorical compiler cannot type the event as coevaluation or evaluation for one object and its chosen dual.

change_budget.instruction: If backend repair exposes another semantic deficiency, stop and report it without changing Independent semantics again.

non_claims: Frozen semantics v4 is not yet sealed.
No typed cut-open compiler has yet been constructed.
No evaluator or invariance theorem is established by this amendment.
